name: Extra Implantation
body:
You can implant more cybertech in your body.

Prerequisite(s): Con 16 or Wis 16.

Benefit(s): One of your implantation slots (your choice) can accommodate one more piece of cybertech than normal.

Special: You can select Extra Implantation multiple times (but not more than once for each slot you possess).
